author: Praxis I
title: Dual BRBG: Global Soft-Whiten + Per-Batch Variance Equalization (alpha_pb=0.5)
abstract: Same as alpha_pb=0.3 but with stronger per-batch variance equalization (alpha_pb=0.5). Tests whether further aligning batch-specific second-order structure in the embedding improves ASW_batch/kBET without harming ARI/NMI/cLISI.
